noInherit.description: If true, the annotation is not inherited by mixins.

interval.description: time interval of time series data. possible values {@link Interval}. data will be presented in this granularity

period.description:
time window specification for data to be retrieved for each dfe input instance. typically, when a data changes for
a timestamp, all possible time windows which would include the timestamp of data that changed.

Syntax is specified by an optional integer followed by a {@link TemporalUnit}.
e.g "24HOUR", "7DAY", "MONTH", "12MONTH", "YEAR" or "24h", "7d", "m", "12m", "y"

"7DAY" period means, if new timeseries data point arrives with timestamp '2017-01-10', all data
from   '2017-01-03' to '2017-01-17' will used to generate multiple inputs with time range of "7Days" starting from
'2017-01-03' and end date not exceeding '2017-01-17'. each input timeseries will have data in "interval" size specified.

@see TemporalUnit

metric.description: metric for which data is loaded in materializing  the DFE instance

frequency.description: frequency of execution (if not interval). THIS IS NOT SUPPORTED.

includeSpec.description: include spec for source object fields to provided when DFE is passed as input to analytic.

lastNWindows.description:
filters last N time-windows resulting from invalidation period.

  e.g. When data changes from '2017-01-11' to '2017-01-15'. and DFE with period ="7DAYS" and Interval="DAY"
 would have created input 12 instances with start dates from '2017-01-04' to  '2017-01-15' each instance with 7 days
 of data. with lastNWindows = 2, will filter to process inputs only from '2017-01-14' and '2017-01-15' each with
 7 days of data.

flattenWindows.description:
flatten all time-windows resulting from invalidation period.
this option can be optionally set in cases when "interval" and "period"
are identical.
example1: interval='Day' and period='1Day'
this will instruct ACE to invoke processSource with 1 TS containing n points as
opposed to n TS each containing 1 point.

triggerDFEs.description: subset of (compound metric) child DFEs that trigger invalidation

title:
The @dfe annotation is used to mark Data Flow Events which are satisfied automatically by the
system from time series as they are produced by the data loader or produced by analytics as
their output.
name: Ann.DFE
